shortDescription: Robinhood-listed ZZZ briefly pushed its market capitalization above $1.3 million. According to Odaily, the narrative originated from an independent investigator who found a swarm phenomenon in Wikipedia edits, and an agent added ZZZ at the start of the content to push the edits lower in the page.
